$comment: Engine-wide defaults shared by every channel. Series files can override `length`; channel files set brand/tone. Machine-specific overrides go in engine.config.local.json (gitignored) or .env.

safe_area.$comment: Pixels to keep clear of platform UI on a 1080x1920 frame (strictest of TikTok / Reels / Shorts). All text must stay inside.

elevenlabs.cost: paid: about $0.08 per 1,000 characters through fal.ai (about $0.05 a video); needs FAL_KEY
elevenlabs.$comment: A hosted voice with natural phrasing; voice_id is an ElevenLabs voice name (George, Daniel, …). It sets its own pace and pauses: a character's speed and pause settings are not used. The two English rates were measured on one 42 s recording (2026-11-19): words a second with its pauses, and its slowest sentence per syllable, for the hook. A voice that speaks another language (the character's voice.language) uses that language's rates; Hebrew's were fitted to two George recordings (2026-11-21, 13.8 s and 37.3 s): a script's length is counted in letters, pauses included (a digit counts as 5 letters, as years are said in long words), within 4% on both; words a second is only for the word budget the writer is given; the hook uses the slowest sentence per letter (Hebrew is written without most vowels, so letters stand in for syllables).

elevenlabs-direct.cost: paid: your own ElevenLabs plan (Creator: about 125,000 characters a month, about 400 a video); needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
elevenlabs-direct.license: ElevenLabs terms (a paid plan includes commercial use)
elevenlabs-direct.$comment: ElevenLabs on the person's own account, for voices fal can't reach: any voice in ElevenLabs' voice library by its voice_id (a paid plan is needed for library voices). Hebrew channels use Erez (AZzja2JCoYeMe9vDQBll), a native Israeli voice. Its Hebrew rates were fitted to two Erez recordings (2026-11-21, 8.9 s and a 31.2 s episode): a script's length in letters with its pauses (within 2% on both), and the hook at 0.12 s a letter (his first sentence took 0.115 s a letter, so the estimate stays on the safe side).

veo.cost: included in the Veo clip price
veo.$comment: The video model speaks the line itself, lip-synced, inside each clip (render-ai-video only).

llm.$comment: agent = the coding agent operating this repo writes drafts/scripts from task files (free). anthropic = Claude API (paid; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and your OK). gemini = Google's Gemini API (paid; needs GEMINI_API_KEY and your OK; `./engine ai-video models` lists the model ids your key can use).

youtube-shorts.ai_disclosure: YouTube Studio > 'Altered or synthetic content'. Required for realistic content; optional (but allowed) for clearly animated content.

tiktok.ai_disclosure: Post settings > 'AI-generated content' toggle. Required when content is significantly AI-generated and realistic.

instagram-reels.ai_disclosure: Advanced settings > 'Add AI label'. Required for photorealistic video or realistic-sounding AI audio.

paint.$comment: render-themed worlds: every place an episode needs is painted with ai_video.image_model (Google, paid; needs GEMINI_API_KEY) at ai_video.rates_usd.image each. Spending stops before an episode would pass its budget.

motion.$comment: render-themed worlds: after the voice, every painted shot is turned into a moving clip as long as it is on screen (fal, paid; needs FAL_KEY), so what it shows really happens (wine pours, drops fall). About $0.85 for a 38 s video with 8 shots. Clips are kept by content, so a re-render does not pay again; spending stops before an episode would pass its budget.

music.$comment: Every video gets a music bed made for it (fal, paid; needs FAL_KEY) and the engine's sound effects (src/audio/sfx/, made once with `./engine sfx`). Both are mixed under the voice at render time; voice.wav and the caption timings never change. The music is kept in the episode's audio/ folder, so a re-render does not pay again.

ai_video.$comment: render-ai-video: realistic footage from Google's Gemini API (paid; needs GEMINI_API_KEY and your OK). Model ids change: `./engine ai-video models` lists the ones your key can use.
